name: Alpinestars
verdict: Owned by Alpinestars S.p.A. (Mazzarolo family). Nothing found.
note: Italian motorsport protection-gear maker (Asolo/Maser, Italy, founded 1963); supplier of race suits, gloves and boots to Nissan Formula E Team. Bloomberg reported in September 2026 that Asian private-equity firms including FountainVest and HSG were considering bids valuing the company at about €1 billion; no sale was announced. Same owner as 'alpinestars-h' and 'alpinestars-c'.
